title: Agreement of paper and coefficient section evaluation
statement: For every scheme Y and commutative ring sheaf R on its pro-etale site, with independent site and coefficient universes as in [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models], let P,I be arbitrary cochain complexes. For all integers j,i, every object U, a degree-j section f of Hom(P,I) over U and a degree-i section x of P over U, the paper evaluation evaluate(Y,R,P,I,j,i,U,f,x) equals coefficientHomSectionApply of the degree-(j,i,i+j) coefficientHomComponent applied to f, evaluated at x. These are the definitions of [lem-sf-coefficient-cochain-tensor-curry] and [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation], with the same chosen product projection.

source.place: paragraph 2, the actual evaluation maps; Stacks Tags 0A8X and 03EO

proof.text: Unfold evaluate and projection, coefficientHomSectionApply, coefficientHomComponent and homComplexπ. Both expressions apply the same chosen product projection of the fixed Hom-complex functor at total degree i+j, then evaluate the resulting local internal-Hom section at the identity slice on x. Reflexivity closes the equality. This argument is independent of boundedness, flatness and injectivity, and also applies in zero or negative degrees.

theorem evaluate_eq_coefficient (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (R : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (P I : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ) (j i : ℤ)
    (U : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt Y)ᵒᵖ)
    (f : ((homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
      (R := R) P I).X j).val.obj U) (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) :
    evaluate.{t, u} Y R P I j i U f x =
      coefficientHomSectionApply.{u, t + 1, t}
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R (P.X i) (I.X (i + j)) U
        ((coefficientHomComponent.{u, t + 1, t}
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R P I j i (i + j) rfl).val.app U f) x
